facts.subject: You have 4 held messages
facts.bodyText: Microsoft 365 has prevented the delivery of 4 messages sent to you. These messages are held in quarantine and will be deleted after 3 days. Release them now to your inbox. Microsoft respects your privacy.

facts.subject: Updated employee handbook - signature required
